$comment: Historical provenance for the five exp-025 artifacts. This is separate from model_bank.json, the runtime attestation manifest.

parameters_weights.mem.layout: 16 neuron rows × 16 input columns, input column varies fastest

parameters_decay.mem.layout: one decay keep factor per neuron

parameters_output_weights.mem.layout: 16 neuron rows × 3 readout values, readout value varies fastest

publication.evidence: All five artifact bytes match the promotion commit and this manifest. This does not attest the mirrored README.

dataset.evidence: The public Hub revision anchors the frozen min-max lineage and contains the v3 parquet shards. The staged JSONL digest is reported in PR #47 and recorded by model_bank.json; the exact parquet-to-JSONL transformation and bytes were not independently verified.

export.q88: signed two's-complement Q8.8: round ties-to-even at ×256, clamp to [-32768,32767], then encode as four uppercase hex digits per LF-terminated word

reported_reproduction.evidence: The rerun reproduced the recorded health and Hamming measurements. The scratch export hashes were not recorded; JSON-to-memory consistency is not a comparison of scratch artifact bytes with the shipped bank.

missing_evidence: Original run record that binds output hashes to the trainer invocation and runtime environment
